title: MLQE-PE: A Multilingual Quality Estimation and Post-Editing Dataset
reasoning: The paper is a technical contribution introducing a dataset for machine translation quality estimation. Although one of its data sources for the Russian-English pair includes Reddit data from a subreddit on religion (`r/antireligious`), this is part of an effort to gather a varied sample of data and is not a core component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or ethics.
